channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: US expects Tehran’s reply to peace deal; ‘clashes’ in Hormuz
item.description: Israel killed 31 people in southern Lebanon on Friday, including a rescue worker, Lebanon's National News Agency said.

item.title: Pentagon releases video of strikes on Iranian oil tankers
item.description: Footage released by the Pentagon shows US strikes on two Iranian oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Al Jazeera reporter witnesses Israeli strikes on Lebanon
item.description: Israel has increased its attacks across southern Lebanon. Al Jazeera’s Obaida Hitto reports from Tyre.

item.title: ASEAN leaders adopt measures to ease economic pain caused by Iran war
item.description: The bloc currently imports more than half of its crude oil from the Middle East.

item.title: More than a dozen reported killed in Israeli attacks on south Lebanon
item.description: Israeli air raids on southern Lebanon escalate ahead of new round of talks expected next week in Washington, DC.

item.title: Rubio says Iranian boats firing at Americans will be ‘blown up’
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio defended the US military’s actions in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran accuses US of 'reckless military adventure'
item.description: Abbas Araghchi says the US attacks each time there is a diplomatic solution on the table.

item.title: Oil prices rise after US and Iran exchange fire in Hormuz strait
item.description: US President Donald Trump says the ceasefire between Washington and Tehran is still in place.

item.title: Fears of renewed Gaza war as Hamas disarmament talks stall
item.description: Israeli media reports suggest Israel is preparing to resume fighting because of the impasse in talks with Hamas.

item.title: The companies making billions from the Iran war
item.description: Through surging profits or soaring share prices, the war has been a boon for some firms.
